chapter_note: This chapter is overwhelmingly substrate: a symmetric four-fold enumeration of light hunters (First Man, Third Ambassador, Jesus, Great Counsel) and four counterparts of darkness (King of Darkness, Evil Counsel, Desire, Law of Sin and Death). Each gets the cosmic mapping pattern: stature, tree, soul/body, ship. Editorial intrusions: (1) opening apostolic frame at i=3, (2) "his holy Church" inserted as Jesus's stature at i=29 — classic ecclesial application of the cosmic-mapping pattern, (3) bridge formula at i=51,53 transitioning from light to dark enumeration, (4) the fourth counterpart of darkness (i=74-82) gets extended with polemical vocabulary (ⲇⲟⲅⲙⲁ, ⲡⲗⲁⲛⲏ, "doctrines", "teaching of Error") — the editor expanding the cosmic Law of Sin/Death to identify contemporary heretical doctrines, (5) closing hortatory exhortation at i=85-86 to "hate them as outsiders." Heavy manuscript damage (75.9%) but the four+four structure is clear. Editorial fatigue actually NEGATIVE — apostolic vocabulary is front-loaded, substrate dominates the second half.
